$comment: Recorded responses from kitsu.io/api/edge. Refresh via `make fixtures-refresh` once that target lands; until then re-curl with the request snippets below.

search_one_piece.json.notes: 5 hits, including anime/13623 with coverImage:null — exercises the null-cover branch in parse_search_response.

anime_one_piece_detail.json.notes: Single-resource response with full posterImage+coverImage, used as the canonical detail-page golden.

anime_null_cover_detail.json.notes: Crayon Shin-chan — currently airing, coverImage:null. Exercises the detail-page banner-fallback branch.

episodes_one_piece.json.notes: First 12 episodes of One Piece. Each carries thumbnail.original; airdate populated; episode number + season number as integers. Exercises the episodes panel + thumbnail-tile branch on the detail page.

search_rezero_season_4_dashed.json.request: GET /anime?filter[text]=Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4&page[size]=20&page[number]=1&fields[anime]=canonicalTitle,titles,abbreviatedTitles,slug,synopsis,startDate,endDate,episodeCount,averageRating,subtype,status,posterImage,coverImage,ageRating,popularityRank
search_rezero_season_4_dashed.json.notes: Kitsu reads a '-' that no letter or digit precedes as an exclusion (the client sends as a gap every '-' that no ASCII letter or digit precedes): this, the provider's Re:ZERO Season 4 title sent as given, answers Zoids Genesis (anime/646) alone.

search_rezero_season_4.json.request: GET /anime?filter[text]=Re:ZERO Starting Life in Another World- Season 4&page[size]=20&page[number]=1&fields[anime]=canonicalTitle,titles,abbreviatedTitles,slug,synopsis,startDate,endDate,episodeCount,averageRating,subtype,status,posterImage,coverImage,ageRating,popularityRank
search_rezero_season_4.json.notes: The same title with the '-' before "Starting" dropped, as the client now sends it: Re:ZERO Season 4 (anime/49746) alone.

search_rezero_season_4_slug_words.json.request: GET /anime?filter[text]=rezero starting life in another world season 4&page[size]=20&page[number]=1&fields[anime]=canonicalTitle,titles,abbreviatedTitles,slug,synopsis,startDate,endDate,episodeCount,averageRating,subtype,status,posterImage,coverImage,ageRating,popularityRank
search_rezero_season_4_slug_words.json.notes: The search term the show key hianime:rezero-starting-life-in-another-world-season-4-4587 makes: anime/49746 alone, slug re-zero-kara-hajimeru-isekai-seikatsu-4, whose titles spell "Re:ZERO" as two words where the key runs them together.

franchise_rel_7730.json.notes: The franchise read of the 2000 JoJo OVA (anime/7730): sequel the 1993 OVA (610), prequel the 2012 series (7158), the Stardust Crusaders series (8063) as alternative_version, and the manga (1899) as adaptation; meta.count 4.

franchise_corpus.json.request: Each anchor walked through GET /api/kitsu/franchise/:id on an app with a throwaway profile, then read back from its metadata cache: every kitsu:franchise-rel:v1:<id> listing the walks read, and each anchor's own entry as the walk's answer carries it (from the anchor's detail read).
franchise_corpus.json.notes: 120 shows: Bleach, Naruto, One Piece, the 27 franchises a development profile had cached, and every entry of the six franchises in the frontend's watch-order fixtures; 123 listings, one of them (Chopper's spin-off, anime/428, which the walk's parent check reads from One Piece) copied from tests/fixtures/franchise/listings.json, recorded the same day. Posters and covers are dropped (null), as nothing that reads this looks at artwork. The first hop's corpus test walks each anchor over these listings and compares the first hop with what the show page draws.
